display_name: Reg Z Appendix J APR Solver
purpose: Reg Z Appendix J actuarial APR solver. Newton-Raphson iteration over the general actuarial equation (12 CFR 1026 Appendix J). Handles regular and irregular payment schedules with odd-days fractional first period. Pure ECMA-262 arithmetic, no floating-point built-ins beyond basic operations. APR accuracy, TRID disclosure, and QM spread test input.
